headline: Major US school districts consider dropping Google Search over AI integration
summary: School districts in New York City, Los Angeles, and Chicago are evaluating alternatives to Google Search due to the company's refusal to unbundle AI features from its search engine for students.
why: This reflects growing institutional pushback against the mandatory integration of generative AI tools in educational environments.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Potential loss of institutional users in the education sector could impact service adoption.
